title: candidate.confidence at proposal time does not reflect evidence quality
trigger: Reading, filtering, ranking, or gating on a candidate atom's `confidence` field before it has been through `admitMemory` -- e.g. designing an auto-accept/auto-triage feature, or any UI sort/filter that treats a candidate's stored confidence as meaningful.
behavior_delta: Do not trust a candidate's stored confidence: it is a constant until evidence is verified at admission. `normalizeProposal` (src/engine/contract.js:53) sets `atom.confidence = cappedConfidence(atom, {authority: 'inferred'})` at proposal time, but `cappedConfidence` -> `reliabilityCeiling` -> `sourceProvenance` reads `atom.evidence_state.artifacts`, which does not exist yet -- evidence is only verified later, inside `admitMemory` (src/engine/lifecycle.js:47), at review. So every model-proposed candidate's stored `confidence` is a constant: RELIABILITY_CAP['agent_claim'] (0.5) times CAPTURE_ORIGIN_FACTOR[capture_origin] (0.9 for model_initiated, 1 for user_explicit) -- 0.45 for the common case, regardless of whether evidence_refs are real, verified, numerous, or absent. Confirmed empirically: three of this project's own pending candidates with different evidence quality (verified files, an unavailable diff reference, unverified tool_output) all show confidence 0.45. To get a real, evidence-based number for a still-candidate atom, call verifyReferences(candidate.evidence_refs, {store, projectId}) then cappedConfidence({...candidate, evidence_state}, {authority: 'validated'}) yourself -- the same two calls admitMemory makes internally to produce the number it actually stamps.

why: Found 2026-09-19 while implementing an auto-accept sweep that filters candidates by confidence threshold -- the first draft filtered on the stored field directly, which would have made the threshold meaningless (everything at 0.45, nothing above unless authority is canonical). Caught before shipping, during the writing-plans self-review, by tracing normalizeProposal and cappedConfidence and cross-checking against this project's own real pending candidates.
